html:
One Flexible Drafter for All Batch Sizes and Hardware

Paper (EAGLE-4) · EAGLE-4 draft for Qwen3.8-27B · Documentation

Figure 1(a) of the EAGLE-4 paper: Qwen3.8-27B on the SPEED-Bench qualitative split, 4× NVIDIA B300, one request, temperature 0. The numbers this release measured with EAGLE-4 are in the support matrix.

EAGLE-4 (Extrapolation Algorithm for Greater Language-model Efficiency) is the latest generation of the EAGLE family for accelerating large language model inference. One drafter adapts its speculative decoding strategy to the batch size, the hardware and the workload, and keeps the target model's output distribution.

The EAGLE-4 draft uses a sliding-window draft layer, a low-rank candidate head and an append-only draft cache. Dense and latent-MoE draft structures are implemented. Qwen3.8-27B with its EAGLE-4 draft is the measured target pair.

This repository is 

eagle-harness
, a pip-installable package (
eagle_harness
) that serves EAGLE-4 drafts on SGLang, vLLM and TokenSpeed through engine plugins. EAGLE-4 sizes the speculative tree from measured draft and verification costs for the batch size, hardware and workload it is running on. It registers through hooks the engine exposes and does not patch the engine at runtime.

The patched engines ship as pinned wheels and container images, not as source trees in this repository:

Engine Hardware Wheel index Image Source
SGLangNVIDIA B300, CUDA 13.0cu130 
ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-sglang:0.1.0
 eagle-hq/sglang
SGLangAMD MI355X, ROCm 7.2rocm not yet published (build it) eagle-hq/sglang
vLLMNVIDIA B300, CUDA 13.0cu130 
ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-vllm:0.1.0
 eagle-hq/vllm
TokenSpeed, experimentalNVIDIA CUDA onlycu130 
ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-tokenspeed:0.1.0
 eagle-hq/tokenspeed

Stock engine packages do not carry the hooks. Release settings is the one place that holds every version pin, index URL and image tag. The wheels are also attached to the v0.1.0 GitHub release.

The support matrix reports every measurement with its conditions, separately for loading, greedy correctness, request features and throughput. Throughput is generated tokens per second of workload time, higher is better. The rows below are the shapes the quickstarts ship. Each one is the mean of two server starts on the SPEED-Bench client at temperature 0.

Engine GPUs Client concurrency No-spec tokens/s EAGLE-4 tokens/s Speedup
SGLang 4× B300, TP4 8 1479.4 2820.6 1.91×
SGLang 4× B300, TP4 64 3925.3 5281.3 1.35×
SGLang 1× MI355X, TP1 8 552.7 1145.9 2.07×
SGLang 1× MI355X, TP1 32 1269.2 1980.8 1.56×
vLLM 4× B300, TP4 1 241.6 722.8 2.99×
vLLM 4× B300, TP4 8 1699.9 2883.9 1.70×

Each speedup divides EAGLE-4 throughput by the same engine's matched no-speculation control. No TokenSpeed throughput is claimed. An unexplained greedy mismatch fails the correctness gate even when the speculative server is faster.

Install one patched engine per environment, then 

eagle-harness==0.1.0
from PyPI. The v0.1.0 GitHub release carries the engine wheels, not 
eagle-harness
. Use Python 3.12 for the CUDA engines and Python 3.10 for the ROCm wheel. The commands read their pins from the release settings file in the checkout. Run them, and start servers, from the directory that contains the checkout. Inside it, 
python -m
would import the source tree's 
eagle_harness/
instead of the installed wheel.

git clone https://github.com/eagle-hq/EAGLE-4
. EAGLE-4/docs/release.env

SGLang on CUDA:

python3.12 -m venv .venv-sglang && source .venv-sglang/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install --extra-index-url "$EAGLE_CUDA_INDEX" \
  --extra-index-url "$EAGLE_TORCH_CUDA_INDEX" "sglang==$EAGLE_SGLANG_VERSION" 'flashinfer-python>=0.7.2'
python -m pip install "eagle-harness==$EAGLE_VERSION"
eagle-harness-check

Or open the release image, which has the engine and EAGLE-4 installed:

docker run --rm --gpus all --ipc host -it \
  -p 127.0.0.1:30000:30000 -v "$PWD/models:/models:ro" \
  --entrypoint bash "$EAGLE_SGLANG_IMAGE"
eagle-harness-check

eagle-harness-check
exits zero when the installed engine provides every hook the plugin needs. It does not prove that kernels run or that generation is correct, so send the quickstart request before you measure anything.

The installation guide has the same steps for vLLM and TokenSpeed, which needs its scheduler and kernel wheels from the same index. SGLang on AMD MI355X installs a hash-locked closure from PyPI, the ROCm index and AMD's indexes: follow SGLang ROCm, then the AMD recipe.

Serve Qwen3.8-27B BF16 with its EAGLE-4 draft on four B300 GPUs. SGLang prices the tree from costs it measures during served rounds, so this recipe needs no offline calibration. The full command with its environment is in the SGLang quickstart:

python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path "$MODEL" --tp-size 4 --dtype bfloat16 \
  --trust-remote-code --attention-backend flashinfer --page-size 1 \
  --max-running-requests 32 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 \
  --disable-overlap-schedule --disable-prefill-cuda-graph --cuda-graph-backend-decode full \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 --context-length 196608 --max-total-tokens 196608 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --disable-radix-cache \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 --random-seed 721 --skip-server-warmup \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE_HARNESS --speculative-draft-model-path "$DRAFT" \
  --speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer \
  --speculative-attention-mode prefill --speculative-num-steps 12 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 4 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 16 \
  --speculative-algorithm-config '{"mode":"serve"}'

Then send a greedy request and check that the response carries generated text:

curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:30000/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text":"Explain how a hash table works.","sampling_params":{"temperature":0,"max_new_tokens":128}}'

The first request compiles kernels and seeds the cost tables, so repeat it before timing.

The other engines have their own recipes. vLLM uses a static tree whose depth stops on calibrated costs, produced once with 

eagle-harness calibrate --engine vllm --model "$MODEL" --draft "$DRAFT" --tp 4
while the GPUs are idle, plus the shipped rounds file. SGLang on MI355X selects the packaged MI355X cost profile automatically. TokenSpeed is experimental and CUDA-only, with a fixed-shape mode for checking generation without cost tables. The calibration guide explains the measurement, and new-model onboarding covers training and exporting a draft for another target.

  • Drafts: EAGLE-4 drafts with the low-rank candidate head, tested with Qwen3.8-27B including its GDN layers. Mamba2 targets and latent-MoE drafts have adapters on SGLang and vLLM. Per-model correctness coverage is in the support matrix.
  • Engines: SGLang (V2 speculative worker), vLLM (Model Runner V2) and experimental TokenSpeed, each through the eagle-harness hooks. On SGLang and vLLM a draft top-k of 1 gives a chain and a larger top-k gives a tree. TokenSpeed implements static and calibrated trees, chains and sampled trees, without prompt logprobs or native no-speculation rounds, and its coverage is limited to the configurations in the support matrix.
  • GPUs: NVIDIA sm_80 and newer, and AMD CDNA2 to CDNA4, through Triton kernels. The kernel tests run on B300 and the other architectures are compile-checked. MI355X is covered by the serving measurements in the support matrix. See kernels.
  • Requests: text only. vLLM tree verification handles greedy and sampled requests and needs an unquantized KV cache. Constrained output takes the correctness fallback in compatibility.
  • Batch: SGLang and vLLM trees and chains admit up to 512 running requests within the engine's KV and recurrent-state capacity. The SGLang tree default is 32, so set 
    --max-running-requests
    for larger batches. No pipeline parallelism. Admission is not a throughput or correctness guarantee. Check the support matrix and the known limits.

  • Thanks to Andy Luo (@andyluo7) and the contributors to the original EAGLE-4 PR 2 for the AMD AITER and Triton kernels on GFX950.
  • Thanks to Andy Luo (@andyluo7), Aditya Nandakumar (@proaditya) and the contributors to the merged AMD series in the original EAGLE-4 PR 4 for AITER/FA3 and Split-KV on GFX950.

summary_zh: EAGLE-4 是 EAGLE 系列最新一代 LLM 推理加速方法，用一个草稿模型根据批大小、硬件和负载自适应调整投机解码策略，同时保持目标模型的输出分布。草稿结构包括滑动窗口草稿层、低秩候选头和只追加的草稿缓存，提供稠密和潜在 MoE 两种结构，目前实测配对为 Qwen3.8-27B。仓库提供可 pip 安装的 eagle_harness，通过引擎插件在 SGLang、vLLM 和 TokenSpeed 上运行，并发布了预构建的 wheel 与容器镜像。在 4×B300 上 SGLang 并发 8 时吞吐从 1,479 提升到 2,821 token/s（1.91 倍），并发 64 时提升 1.35 倍。
title_zh: EAGLE-4,EAGLE-4的官方推理代码,下载EAGLE-4的源码_GitHub_帮酷
html_zh:
一款适用于所有批量大小和硬件的灵活绘图机

论文 (EAGLE-4) · Qwen3.8-27B 的 EAGLE-4 草案·文档

EAGLE-4 论文的图 1(a)：SPEED-Bench 定性分割上的 Qwen3.8-27B，4× NVIDIA B300，一个请求，温度 0。此版本使用 EAGLE-4 测量的数字位于支持矩阵中。

EAGLE-4（提高语言模型效率的外推算法）是 EAGLE 系列的最新一代，用于加速大型语言模型推理。一名起草者根据批量大小、硬件和工作负载调整其推测解码策略，并保持目标模型的输出分布。

EAGLE-4 草案使用滑动窗口草案层、低等级候选头和仅附加草案缓存。实施密集和潜在的 MoE 草案结构。 Qwen3.8-27B 及其EAGLE-4 拔模是测量的目标对。

这个存储库是

eagle-harness
，一个 pip 可安装包（
eagle_harness
）通过引擎插件在 SGLang、vLLM 和 TokenSpeed 上提供 EAGLE-4 草案。 EAGLE-4 根据测得的草稿和批次大小、硬件和运行工作负载的验证成本来确定推测树的大小。它通过引擎公开的钩子进行注册，并且不会在运行时修补引擎。

修补后的引擎作为固定轮和容器映像提供，而不是作为此存储库中的源树：

引擎 硬件 轮指数 图像 来源
西格朗英伟达 B300、CUDA 13.0与 130 
ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-sglang:0.1.0
 鹰总部/sglang
西格朗AMD MI355X，ROCm 7.2罗姆 尚未发布（构建它） 鹰总部/sglang
LLM英伟达 B300、CUDA 13.0与 130 
ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-vllm:0.1.0
 伊格尔总部/vllm
TokenSpeed，实验性的仅限 NVIDIA CUDA与 130 
ghcr.io/eagle-hq/eagle-4-tokenspeed:0.1.0
 eagle-hq/tokenspeed

库存发动机套件不带有挂钩。发布设置是保存每个版本 pin、索引 URL 和图像标签的地方。轮子也附在v0.1.0 GitHub 版本上。

支持矩阵报告每个测量及其条件，分别针对加载、贪婪正确性、请求特征和吞吐量。吞吐量是工作负载时间每秒生成的令牌，越高越好。下面的行是快速入门提供的形状。每一个都是 SPEED-Bench 客户端上温度为 0 时启动的两台服务器的平均值。

引擎 GPU 客户端并发数 无规格代币 EAGLE-4 代币/秒 加速比
西格朗 4× B300、TP4 8 1479.4 2820.6 1.91×
西格朗 4× B300、TP4 64 3925.3 5281.3 1.35×
西格朗 1× MI355X，TP1 8 552.7 1145.9 2.07×
西格朗 1× MI355X，TP1 32 1269.2 1980.8 1.56×
LLM 4× B300、TP4 1 241.6 722.8 2.99×
LLM 4× B300、TP4 8 1699.9 2883.9 1.70×

每次加速都会将 EAGLE-4 吞吐量除以同一引擎匹配的无推测控制。未声明 TokenSpeed 吞吐量。即使推测服务器速度更快，无法解释的贪婪不匹配也会导致正确性门失败。

每个环境安装一个已修补的引擎，然后

eagle-harness==0.1.0
来自 PyPI。这v0.1.0 GitHub 发布携带发动机轮，而不是
eagle-harness
。使用 Python 3.12 作为 CUDA 引擎，使用 Python 3.10 作为 ROCm 轮。这些命令从结账时的发布设置文件中读取其引脚。从包含结帐的目录运行它们并启动服务器。在里面，
python -m
将导入源树的
eagle_harness/
而不是安装的轮子。

git clone https://github.com/eagle-hq/EAGLE-4
. EAGLE-4/docs/release.env

CUDA 上的 SGLang：

python3.12 -m venv .venv-sglang && source .venv-sglang/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install --extra-index-url "$EAGLE_CUDA_INDEX" \
  --extra-index-url "$EAGLE_TORCH_CUDA_INDEX" "sglang==$EAGLE_SGLANG_VERSION" 'flashinfer-python>=0.7.2'
python -m pip install "eagle-harness==$EAGLE_VERSION"
eagle-harness-check

或者打开已安装引擎和 EAGLE-4 的发布映像：

docker run --rm --gpus all --ipc host -it \
  -p 127.0.0.1:30000:30000 -v "$PWD/models:/models:ro" \
  --entrypoint bash "$EAGLE_SGLANG_IMAGE"
eagle-harness-check

eagle-harness-check
当安装的引擎提供插件所需的每个钩子时，退出为零。它不能证明内核运行或生成是正确的，因此在测量任何内容之前发送快速启动请求。

vLLM和TokenSpeed的安装指南具有相同的步骤，它需要来自同一索引的调度程序和内核轮。 AMD MI355X 上的 SGLang 安装来自 PyPI、ROCm 索引和 AMD 索引的哈希锁定闭包：遵循SGLang ROCm ，然后是AMD Recipe 。

在四个 B300 GPU 上使用其 EAGLE-4 草案来服务 Qwen3.8-27B BF16。 SGLang 根据其在服务轮次中测量的成本对树进行定价，因此该配方不需要离线校准。完整的命令及其环境位于SGLang 快速入门中：

python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path "$MODEL" --tp-size 4 --dtype bfloat16 \
  --trust-remote-code --attention-backend flashinfer --page-size 1 \
  --max-running-requests 32 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 \
  --disable-overlap-schedule --disable-prefill-cuda-graph --cuda-graph-backend-decode full \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 --context-length 196608 --max-total-tokens 196608 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 16384 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --disable-radix-cache \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 --random-seed 721 --skip-server-warmup \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE_HARNESS --speculative-draft-model-path "$DRAFT" \
  --speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer \
  --speculative-attention-mode prefill --speculative-num-steps 12 \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 4 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 16 \
  --speculative-algorithm-config '{"mode":"serve"}'

然后发送一个贪婪请求并检查响应是否携带生成的文本：

curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:30000/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text":"Explain how a hash table works.","sampling_params":{"temperature":0,"max_new_tokens":128}}'

第一个请求编译内核并为成本表播种，因此在计时之前重复它。

其他引擎有自己的配方。 vLLM使用静态树，其深度停止于校准成本，生成一次

eagle-harness calibrate --engine vllm --model "$MODEL" --draft "$DRAFT" --tp 4
当 GPU 空闲时，加上发送的回合文件。MI355X 上的 SGlang自动选择打包的 MI355X 成本配置文件。TokenSpeed是实验性的，仅限 CUDA，具有固定形状模式，用于在没有成本表的情况下检查生成。这校准指南解释测量结果，以及新模式入职涵盖训练和导出另一个目标的草案。

  • 草稿：使用低排名候选头的 EAGLE-4 草稿，使用 Qwen3.8-27B（包括其 GDN 层）进行测试。 Mamba2 目标和潜在 MoE 草案在 SGLang 和 vLLM 上有适配器。每个模型的正确性覆盖范围位于支持矩阵中。
  • 引擎：SGLang（V2 投机工作者）、vLLM（Model Runner V2）和实验性 TokenSpeed，每个引擎都通过 eagle-harness hooks 实现。在 SGLang 和 vLLM 上，草稿 top-k 为 1 会给出一条链，较大的 top-k 会给出一棵树。 TokenSpeed 实现静态和校准树、链和采样树，无需提示 logprobs 或本机无推测回合，其覆盖范围仅限于支持矩阵中的配置。
  • GPU：NVIDIA sm_80 及更新版本，以及 AMD CDNA2 至 CDNA4，通过 Triton 内核。内核测试在 B300 上运行，其他架构均经过编译检查。支持矩阵中的服务测量涵盖了 MI355X。参见内核。
  • 要求：仅限文字。 vLLM 树验证处理贪婪和采样请求，需要未量化的 KV 缓存。受限输出在兼容性方面采取了正确性回退。
  • 批处理：SGLang 和 vLLM 树和链在引擎的 KV 和循环状态容量内最多允许 512 个运行请求。 SGLang树默认是32，所以设置
    --最大运行请求数
    对于较大批量。没有管道并行性。准入并不是吞吐量或正确性的保证。检查支持矩阵和已知限制。
